_comment: The featured startup shown at the top of the list. Written by the /feature slash command, read by featured.js in the browser. `current` is what renders; `history` is the ledger that stops a company being featured twice. Set current to null to show nothing.

current.blurb: The bottleneck in vulnerability management is rarely finding the flaw — it is chasing down which team owns the affected system, filing the ticket, and proving the fix actually happened. Cogent puts agents on that coordination work and verifies the patch landed.
